description: This source file is a shell script used in openwrt build system for device platform upgrade procedures. It contains functions for preparing initramfs, checking images, preparing upgrade steps, and executing device-specific upgrade logic based on board names.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares initramfs environment for Xiaomi devices by erasing and formatting specific MTD partitions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a simple check of the image validity; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade, particularly for Xiaomi Ax6/AX3600/AX9000 models.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that executes device-specific upgrade procedures based on the device's board name.
